summary: Elicio Therapeutics, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for an underwritten public offering of 4,380,313 shares of common stock at $3.43 per share, expected to close on July 6, 2026. Titan Partners and B. Riley Securities act as placement agents on a reasonable best efforts basis, with a 7.0% cash fee. This is a routine capital raise, not a special-situation transaction. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change is involved. The filing is a standard shelf takedown for growth capital.
